parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the period of a pendulum. Carry out the following instructions, referring to Fig. 1.1 and Fig. 1.2. Fig. 1.1 Fig. 1.2 A pendulum labelled A has been set up for you as shown in Fig. 1.1.

parts.text: (a) Adjust the length of the pendulum until the distance d measured from the bottom of the clamp to the centre of the bob is 50.0 cm.
